text:
noah: FYI running into onboarding friction with the js-sdk package export change (v2.4.x). Edge sample fails during dev with syntax errors and our auth code issues a pair of token requests. Repro is with Workers + Vite.
priya: what does package.json exports look like now?
noah: we switched to conditional exports to prefer esm: ```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
ivan: hmm classic. Some bundlers (esp older wrangler/vite combos) will treat the import target as ESM but then still wrap things in a CJS runtime shim. If an .mjs is compiled into a bundle with `require()` wrappers you can get the "Cannot use import statement outside a module" at runtime.
tara: the double token fetch sounds like the auth adapter is being initialized twice: once during bundle init and once after runtime hydration. Did you see duplicated init logs?
noah: yes: `auth:init` then `auth:init` again within 100ms. Network shows two POST /v1/token requests. Stack points to `init -> fetchToken -> init` (weird circular).
priya: possible root-causes: 1) mixed bundles causing two copies of the SDK to load (different entrypoints), 2) our runtime feature-detect runs too early and triggers fetch, 3) export map resolved both import and require in a build-time transform.
ivan: quick local test: `import 'redwood-js-sdk'` vs `import 'redwood-js-sdk/dist/esm/edge.mjs'`. The explicit path avoids export map resolution and the bundler stops rewriting the import. Does that work for you?
noah: yes, explicit import fixes the syntax error and the double-auth goes away. Not acceptable as long term though.
tara: options: - revert export map change and ship compatibility patch, - keep exports but update samples/docs to recommend pinned ESM imports for edge, - improve SDK init to be idempotent so duplicate loads don't double-call auth.
priya: I'd prefer hardening init first (debounce token fetch / guard against duplicate module instances) + docs. Reverting export map is last resort.
ivan: also consider adding an explicit `exports` condition for `worker`/`edge` (nonstandard) is risky, but we've seen projects add a `./edge` entry consumers can import. Could ship `dist/esm/edge.mjs` and document it.
noah: agree. For immediate triage: I'll update edge sample README with explicit import, add a comment in the sample's package.json about pinning the entry to avoid bundler rewrite.
tara: create an issue so we can track DX + CI work. Also add an integration check in CI that runs the edge sample with wrangler dev (or a fast headless check) to catch this.
ci-bot: Created RDW-5310: "SDK export map + bundler interplay breaks edge samples and causes duplicate auth init" (labels: devex, sdk-exports, edge-ci)
priya: assign to @ivan for a short-term patch to init idempotency and to @noah for sample README PR.
ivan: I'll prototype a guard: a small module-scoped boolean to mark init in progress and make fetchToken wait if already running. Also will log module filename/resolution to detect duplicate instances (helps debugging bundler duplication).
noah: PR opened for sample README: pinned import example + recommended wrangler/vite flags. Link: github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/123
tara: Nice. Let's also add a tiny troubleshooting doc snippet in dev docs explaining: "If you see import syntax errors on Cloudflare/Vite, try explicit ESM entry or set preserveEntrySignatures/build configs".
priya: agree. Once ivan has a safe idempotency patch, we can release v2.4.1 with notes and not revert exports.
ivan: will post a short repro branch with a failing test so CI can catch it. ETA EOD.
noah: thanks all. Saved a customer onboarding headache. :relieved:
